archwiz/archwiz.py (3)
`110-162`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Hardcoded `python3` breaks on interpreter mismatch.** Every child process starts with the bare name `python3`, resolved through `PATH`. If the dashboard runs under a virtual environment or a non-default interpreter, the child processes use a different Python and can miss dependencies. Ruff reports S607 on all of these lines. Use `sys.executable`, which the module already imports on Line 8. - `archwiz/archwiz.py#L110-L162`: replace `'python3'` with `sys.executable` in the dispatch branches on Lines 113, 115, 117, 119, 127, 128, 129, 130, 141, 143, 145, 149, 151, 152, 154, and 156. - `archwiz/archwiz.py#L61-L77`: replace `'python3'` with `sys.executable` in the `listener_control.py` start and stop calls on Lines 68 and 74.

Apply the same replacement to the listener_control.py start and stop calls in archwiz.py lines 61-77. ```

If the listener process already runs, the first `p` press calls `listener_control.py start` and can start a second listener. Query the real state from `listener_control.py` (for example a `status` subcommand or a PID file) at startup instead of assuming a fixed value.
